'''Vont''' was a [[Duke/Legends|duchess]] who lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Shi'ido]] bodyguard [[Brong]] protected the duchess, and kept thieves away from her belongings.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
